subject: Hosting & region decision for Sable MAP — milestones and lock dates
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@bleedingedge.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: hosting & region decision for Sable MAP

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the ability to run rollouts across modes. We're trying to lock the Mutual Action Plan (attached) so procurement and security can line up resources. Key constraints from our side: PHI will be in scope and we need an auditable path for a Private deployment, but org is open to a short POC on Hosted if we can get guaranteed data handling controls and a plan to move to Private later.

What we'd like from Redwood to proceed:
- A clear proposed evaluation plan (timeline, owners) that shows Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private option lanes;
- Region recommendations for production + DR for PHI workloads;
- Rough legal/contract milestones and an estimated time to close the first purchase order (we're targeting a pilot buy by mid-June).

I've attached our current MAP (Sable_MAP_v3.pdf) and a short compliance checklist. Can you propose dates for locking hosting mode and region next week?

Best,
Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Platform, Sable Health
maya@bleedingedge.com

Attachments: Sable_MAP_v3.pdf (PDF)
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@bleedingedge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: hosting & region decision for Sable MAP

Maya — thanks for the MAP. I've reviewed and sketched a recommended evaluation path below (high level) to keep you on the mid-June pilot target while preserving the Private option for PHI. See inline plan and ask at the bottom.

Proposed evaluation lanes (owners):
1) POC (Hosted) — quick verification of latency, throughput, and redaction hooks. Owner: Priya (Redwood) / Ben (Sable Eng). Timeline: 2 weeks (Apr 28 — May 12).
2) Pilot (Dedicated) — predictable throughput for early users, capacity-reserved. Owner: Karthik (Redwood Ops) / Sable Eng. Timeline: May 13 — Jun 2 (validation, performance testing, cost modelling).
3) Regulated go/no-go (Private) — VPC private control plane, KMS integration, SOC2 audit artifacts requested. Owner: Soojin (Redwood Security) / Sable Sec. Target lock date: Jun 15 for pilot purchases; full Private cutover TBD based on compliance sign-off.

Region suggestions (initial):
- Production: us-west-2 (data residency + low latency to your west coast customers)
- DR/backup: us-east-1 (geo separation)
- EU: we can stand up eu-west-1 if you have EU patients — will require extra paperwork for data flow.

Risks and mitigations:
- PHI in Hosted: allow a scoped POC with tokenized redaction + temporary logs retention; Redwood can provide short-term retention and KMS-backed encryption as a mitigant.
- SLA/throughput: Dedicated reserved pool addresses predictable throughput; we'll provide per-route SLOs for the pilot.

Legal & procurement milestones (rough):
- SOW + pricing sheet: 1 week after hosting decision
- Mutual NDA addendum for PHI: 1–2 weeks
- PO issuance: typically 1–3 weeks after SOW sign-off (depends on your procurement)

Can you confirm: (a) internal sign-off authority for PHI decisions (name/title), (b) any hard blackout dates for May that would affect testing? We'll lock hosting mode by May 10 if we get confirmation by EOD May 6.

I'll attach our proposed SLA draft and a compliance Q&A to the MAP for your SOC2 team.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: SLA_Draft.docx (DOCX), Compliance_QA.xlsx (XLSX)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: hosting & region decision for Sable MAP

Folks — quick technical notes to fold into the MAP before we send to Sable: 

- Peak concurrency estimate: we'll need Sable's expected QPS per user tier to size the Dedicated pool. If you can share the projected 95th perc throughput (or a small sample trace) we can be precise.
- Latency SLOs: for POC Hosted we expect ~120–160ms p50 on short prompts (<=128 tokens). Dedicated gives us predictable p95s once the pool is reserved.
- Data plane region: agree with us-west-2 for prod, us-east-1 for DR. For PHI, the Private lane will require KMS integration and HSM-backed keys if your compliance team asks — that adds a 2–3 week ops window.

I'll add these as bullet items in the MAP doc. Priya — can you confirm deal_id so I can reference it in the internal resource request?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Operations, Redwood

Maya / Ken — thanks for the quick turnaround. Below is our consolidated mutual action plan excerpt with explicit lock dates so your procurement and security teams can align. I'm copying internal owners.

Executive summary (single line): Redwood proposes a three-lane evaluation that preserves a PHI-ready Private path while enabling a fast Hosted POC and a Dedicated pilot — lock hosting mode by 2027-05-10 and region by 2027-05-17 to meet your mid-June pilot target.

Agreed milestones (owners & dates):
- May 6 (Sable): confirm authority and provide sample trace + any blackout dates (owner: Ken).
- May 10 (Decision point): hosting mode locked (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for pilot). Owner: Sable Exec + Priya (Redwood).
- May 12: Redwood sends SOW + pricing sheet (Priya).
- May 17: region lock for pilot (Priya/Karthik).
- Jun 2: Dedicated validation complete (Karthik/Sable Eng).
- Jun 15: Pilot purchase / go-live milestone (Sable procurement).

Next steps for Redwood (this week):
1) Update the MAP PDF with the three-lane timeline and technical bullets (done; attached).
2) Share a sample config for tokenized redaction and short retention (Soojin will share).
3) Draft SOW + pricing and push to Ken by May 3.

Open asks for Sable:
- Confirm whether the initial POC may run on Hosted with redaction and a documented retention window.
- Provide sample traffic trace for sizing.
- Any procurement blackout dates in May.

I'll include the updated MAP and SLA draft in the HubSpot deal record and send a DocuSign link for the SOW once you confirm the hosting lane.

Thanks — Priya
